features.label: Tall lower leg coverage
features.text: The tall shell extends up the lower leg to support distal tibial fractures and Achilles tendon injuries

features.label: Pneumatic air compression
features.text: A side mounted pump and release valve let you fine-tune compression to manage swelling

features.label: Plastic or aluminum struts
features.text: Choose durable plastic for a contoured shell or lightweight aluminum for strong support

features.label: Rocker bottom sole
features.text: Contoured sole encourages a smooth heel-to-toe gait to reduce stress during walking

features.label: Adjustable toe cover
features.text: Built-in guard shields injured toes and is easy to reposition or remove

features.label: Removable heel clip
features.text: Detaches to accommodate Achilles tendon wedges when prescribed

features.label: Breathable contoured liner
features.text: Wide footbed and breathable liner reduce pressure points for extended wear
